status_as_of_cutoff: Local process / approved-permitted but under appeal: Colorado Springs official records show a Development Plan Modification approval letter for DEPN-26-0039 dated June 10, 2026, approved development-plan sheets stamped June 11, 2026, and a July 23 Planning Commission appeal docket for APPL-26-0003 through APPL-26-0007. Colorado Public Radio reported the Planning Commission upheld the administrative approval on July 23 by a 6-2 vote, and then reported on August 6 that the decision had again been appealed to City Council, with a hearing required between August 29 and September 28, 2026. Construction, building permits, certificate of occupancy, utility service, and energization remain unestablished.
evidence_grade: B: official city planning documents verify the project, developer, address, June 2026 development-plan approval, approved-plan conditions, and July 23 appeal docket; Planning Commission vote, 50 MW cap, and City Council appeal timing are supported by local reporting because final city minutes/action records were not posted in the reviewed public Legistar surface.

actions.government_body: City of Colorado Springs Planning and Development
actions.result_status: The city posted a notice for a neighborhood meeting concerning a potential development-plan modification to establish data-center use and site improvements at 1565 High Tech Way.
actions.access_caveat: The city says neighborhood meetings are hosted by applicants, not the city; this notice is not an approval.
actions.evidence_note: Official project identity and record number; not a land-use approval.

actions.government_body: City of Colorado Springs Land Use Review Division
actions.result_status: The city approval letter says the Land Use Review Division administratively approved the Corporate Ridge Filing No. 1 Lot 4 Development Plan Modification, establishing a data center use in the existing industrial building and site improvements on the 21.96-acre BP-zoned site at 1565 High Tech Way.
actions.access_caveat: The approval letter states June 10, while approved plan sheets are stamped June 11 and the staff report describes approval on June 11.
actions.evidence_note: Official approval letter; appealability and final status remain open because subsequent appeals were filed.

actions.government_body: Colorado Springs Planning Department / Planning Commission (reported by The Gazette; disposition not retrieved)
actions.result_status: The Gazette reported appeals filed against the administrative approval. The appeal record and disposition were not located.
actions.access_caveat: Press report; no appeal outcome is inferred.

actions.government_body: City of Colorado Springs Planning and Development
actions.result_status: The city-posted Sound Monitoring Plan for Project Taurus establishes pre-construction and post-construction monitoring, complaint procedures, public monthly reporting once operational, and noise-remediation procedures tied to DEPN-26-0039.
actions.access_caveat: Operational compliance will depend on later construction and monitoring records.

actions.result_status: The official Legistar meeting record and agenda list the July 23 appeal hearing for APPL-26-0003 through APPL-26-0007 concerning the DEPN-26-0039 administrative approval. Colorado Public Radio reported that the Planning Commission upheld the planning department approval and that the appeal failed 6-2.
actions.vote_tally: 6-2 reported by CPR; official minutes/action fields were not available in the reviewed Legistar record
actions.access_caveat: The official Legistar page confirms the hearing item and attachments but shows no finalized action/result; vote and outcome rely on local reporting.

actions.government_body: Colorado Springs City Council / City Planning appeal process (reported)
actions.result_status: Colorado Politics reported at least one successful appeal, later described as two apparent successful appeals, sending the Planning Commission decision to City Council. CPR reported on August 6 that the City Council must hear the matter between August 29 and September 28, 2026 and that a city official expected mid-September.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: DEPN-26-0039; City Council appeal file not retrieved
actions.access_caveat: City Council appeal filing and hearing date were not found in an official Legistar action item during this pass.
actions.evidence_note: Reported appeal status; final City Council disposition pending.

capacity_mw_note: Reported Planning Commission condition limiting project power use to 50 MW; official final action/minutes were not posted in the reviewed Legistar record and City Council appeal remains pending.
